evals.expected_output: Agent recognizes the message lacks a why, infers the why from the diff/conversation if possible, and writes a message that captures the motivation rather than the mechanics.
expectations: Does not commit the bare mechanical message as-is
Infers the motivation from conversation context or the diff when available
Produces a commit message that explains WHY, not just what changed

evals.expected_output: With no conversation context and an ambiguous diff, the agent asks a diff-grounded clarifying question rather than inventing a why.
expectations: Asks the user for the motivation when it cannot be inferred
The question is grounded in the actual diff, not generic
Eventually runs the commit after the why is established

evals.prompt: Ready to commit — this fixes the login timeout by refreshing the JWT before expiry.
evals.expected_output: The why is already present in context; the agent commits without an unnecessary clarifying question, with a message capturing the JWT-refresh motivation.
expectations: Does not ask a redundant clarifying question when the why is already clear
The commit message captures the JWT-refresh motivation
Uses the sentinel/commit mechanism correctly (sentinel exists before commit, removed after)
